definitions.explanation: A person who has achieved notable success, typically in business, career, or life goals. Often implies wealth or social status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成功者|せいこうしゃ}だ。
{成功者|せいこうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are habits common to successful people.

examples.japanese: {成功者|せいこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many successful people experienced major failures when they were young.

notes:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧ (success) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Commonly used in self-help books, business articles, and motivational contexts. The word often implies financial or career success rather than personal fulfillment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成功者|せいこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧: secrets of successful people
- {成功者|せいこうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to learn from successful people
- {成功者|せいこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: the way successful people think
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成功者|せいこうしゃ}: a person successful in life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}: winner (in life/society) — more colloquial and sometimes used cynically
- ⟦{実業家|じつぎょうか}→実業家：12294_jitsugyouka⟧: businessperson; entrepreneur — focuses on the business role, not the success itself
- {立志伝中|りっしでんちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: self-made person — emphasizes rising from humble origins through determination
